title: Density exists at every point of U and is upper semicontinuous (Simon Ch. 4, 4.9 and 3.11; parent steps 6-7)
statement: Let n >= 1, U an open subset of R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu, H : R^(n+l) -> R^(n+l) such that V has generalized mean curvature H in U, p > n real with H locally in L^p(mu) on U (int_K |H|^p dmu < infinity for compact K contained in U), and assume (G2) x -> P_x := tangentProj_V(x) is mu-a.e. strongly measurable and (G1) for mu-a.e. x, P_x is the orthogonal projection onto an n-dimensional subspace. Then for every xi in U there is a real d >= 0 with Theta^n(mu, xi) = d, i.e. mu(B_r(xi))/(omega_n r^n) -> d as r -> 0+ (closed balls; V.HasDensity xi d), and Theta^n(mu, .) is upper semicontinuous at xi: for every eps > 0 there is a neighbourhood N of xi such that every y in N and every real t with V.HasDensity y t satisfy t <= d + eps.
lean_statement: ∀ {n ℓ : ℕ} {U : Set (Amb n ℓ)} (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ) (p : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → (n : ℝ) < p → V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V.LocallyLp H p → AEStronglyMeasurable V.tangentProj V.weight → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), Module.finrank ℝ P = n ∧ V.tangentProj x = P.starProjection) → ∀ ξ ∈ U, ∃ d : ℝ, 0 ≤ d ∧ V.HasDensity ξ d ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 ξ, ∀ t : ℝ, V.HasDensity y t → t ≤ d + ε
